counterexample: 4[k] -> 2[k+1] (base 2 with digits 0..3): the stable configurations '2' and '10' both have value 2. Also 4[k] -> [k+2] on all levels, 4[k] -> 2[k+2], 4[k] -> 2[k+3] (EXP-C02-04).
